nodes.name: Grouped TP/SL Fix Deployed (normalTpsl)
nodes.summary: Jun 2 13:20: single bulk_orders call with grouping='normalTpsl' replaces post-entry TP/SL attachment. HL auto-cancels TP on SL hit. Ghost loop eliminated. Cost to date: ~$47 across 9 days. Supersedes tp-sl-workaround-resting-orders.

nodes.name: Execution Monitor — 5 Anomaly Detectors Deployed
nodes.summary: Jun 2 12:47-13:10: 5 detectors: rapid_churn (position count change), ghost_loop (same position close+reopen), balance_drift (balance change threshold), slippage_blowout (fill vs signal price), tpsl_emergency (trade without native TP/SL). Auto kill-switch on critical. First self-diagnostic layer for the live trading system.

nodes.name: Global Risk Restructure — Flat-Dollar Risk + Single-Slot Rule
nodes.summary: Jun 2 19:24-19:30: ALLOC_*=1.0 ($19.12/trade) replaces percentage allocation. Single-slot rule: 1 position/symbol max, 4 portfolio max. BB_1H_SYMBOLS allowlist enforced. Ecosystem correlation gate (ETH/ARB co-hold prevented). Choke Collar: variance-gated risk reduction. At $956 account, 2% risk per trade.

nodes.name: CPSO Framework — Strategic Alter Ego Authority
nodes.summary: Jun 2: Wosobu explicitly references CPSO as strategic alter ego. CPSO directives carry higher authority than tactical requests. First major act: global risk restructure (alloc=1.0, single-slot, BB_1H). CPSO > standard Wosobu for risk decisions. Escalation path for strategic decisions routed through CPSO persona.

nodes.name: Knowledge-Execution Gap Pattern — Known Fixes Not Deployed
nodes.summary: Repeating pattern: correct fix documented in semantic nodes/memory but not wired into executing code. Instances: (1) HL balance endpoint docs vs broken clearinghouseState (May 24), (2) PAPER_MODE_FORCE concept vs missing in ad-hoc scripts (May 29), (3) kill switch state fix vs cron enabled flag (Jun 1), (4) TP/SL resting order workaround vs post-entry attachment in auto-entry (May 25-Jun 2, ~$47 cost). Root cause: documentation/code decoupling. Partially addressed by Execution Monitor (runtime detection) but not prevention.
